[SWS_DM_01781] (Re-)Identification of Clients by Token
⌈
For any sub-
sequent request that is processed no later than the validUntil returned from the
ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorization and where the
authorization token is identical, the Diagnostic Server instance shall consider
the client as being identical.
⌋
